title: Quote: (on why he is brutal to most colleagues) I'm brutally honest...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Insights on the writing of Steve Jobs
content: (on why he is brutal to most colleagues) I'm brutally honest, because the price of admission to being in the room with me is I get to tell you your full of shit if you're full of shit, and you get to say to me I'm full of shit, and we have some rip-roaring fights. And that keeps the B players, the bozos, from larding the organization, only the A players survive. And the people who do survive, say, 'Yeah, he was rough.' They say things even worse than 'He cut in line in front of me,' but they say, 'This was the greatest ride I've ever had, and I would not give it up for anything.'
